extraction.name: RoboFAC dataset
extraction.description: A large-scale and diverse dataset for question-answering on robot failure videos, comprising 9,440 erroneous manipulation trajectories and 78,623 QA pairs across 16 diverse tasks and 53 scenes in both simulation and real-world environments.
extraction.creator: Weifeng Lu, Minghao Ye, Zewei Ye, Ruihan Tao, Shuo Yang, Bo Zhao
extraction.citeAs: Weifeng Lu, Minghao Ye, Zewei Ye, Ruihan Tao, Shuo Yang, Bo Zhao. RoboFAC: A Comprehensive Framework for Robotic Failure Analysis and Correction. arXiv:2505.12224v3, 2025.
extraction.rai:dataCollection: Simulation data collected for 14 robotic tasks in the ManiSkill environment augmented with objects from the YCB Object Dataset and scenes from ReplicaCAD and AI2-THOR. Real-world data collected for 6 tasks via teleoperation using the SO-100 robotic arm.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionMissingData: Motion planning for the robotic arm occasionally failed, resulting in trajectories that did not align with the corresponding textual descriptions; approximately 25% of the collected data was discarded during manual data cleaning.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Robotic failure videos along with corresponding descriptive texts including the substage where the failure occurred, the taxonomy of failure, and a detailed textual explanation of the error.
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: To generate failure data, the original expert policy was replaced with a code snippet that generates an erroneous trajectory at the selected substage, causing the overall robotic task to fail.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Manual data cleaning was performed to remove trajectories that did not align with textual descriptions, retaining approximately 75% of the collected data.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Raw data was annotated to construct video-based QA samples for eight question types. For five question types (task identification, task planning, failure detection, failure identification, failure locating), reference answers were extracted directly from textual descriptions. For the remaining three types (failure explanation, high-level correction, low-level correction), GPT-4o was used to generate reference answers based on the video and textual description, followed by manual review and correction.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: To ensure annotation quality, all outputs from GPT-4o were manually reviewed and corrected.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: The integration of the model into the VLA-controlled robotic system is not yet seamless. The model is applied exclusively to the VLA model. The success rate remains subject to further enhancement, largely due to the VLA model’s limited ability to follow complex natural language instructions.
